messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: P1 ALERT for customer AsterHealth — dedicated pool 'solarisd-prod' reporting tool-call parse errors in production (fncall responses failing JSON parse). Pager: eng-oncall. Incident ID: INC-2026-9802
oncall-bot: Automations: created incident INC-2026-9802, page sent to @Priya Patel and @Drew Kim. Runbook: fncall-parser-drifts -> follow triage steps.
Priya Patel: acked. I’m online, pulling logs now. Can someone grab the last 10m from the pool? rbctl logs --pool solarisd-prod --since 10m (I'll grab traces)
Drew Kim: grabbing. Saw a spike in 502s and parser exceptions starting ~2176543000. Pushing logs to #s3-temp.
Marta Alvarez: quick note — customer reported increased app errors and retries. CS says about ~15% of requests failing with 500s in last 5m.
Samir Nair: pasting example payload from runtime that fails JSON.parse in tool response handler:
```
{"tool_response":"{\"status\":\"ok\", \"payload\": null}"}
```
Parser error: Unexpected token n in JSON at position 30 — looks like double-encoded string with null literal. Some responses are returning literal null where object expected.
Priya Patel: interesting — our parser expects `payload` to be an object. If model/toolchain started returning JSON strings or `null` for some calls, the strict parser breaks. Could be a schema drift in the customer's tool adapter or a model/system update.
TriageBot: Timeline: first error 2176542996, error rate 0.14 -> now 0.62. Impact: 4% of global requests, 100% bucketed to solarisd-prod (dedicated).
Drew Kim: I ran a quick grep across recent responses — about 18% of fncall responses include "payload": null instead of {...}; some have escaped JSON inside a string: "payload":"{\"id\":123}".
Elena Sousa: CS reports customer UI shows "unable to parse tool output" and some jobs are stuck in retry loop. They want ETA on mitigation.
Priya Patel: Mitigation plan (short): 1) Enable tolerant parser flag on pool (runtime config) that treats null/string as valid and attempts safe coercion. 2) Route new traffic to standby pool solarisd-standby if available. 3) Roll back recent model variant if we see a rollout. 4) Patch parsing logic in edge to avoid 500s and return 502 with safe-error for customer to handle.
Samir Nair: steps I can run now: 
- rdctl pool update solarisd-prod --set tolerant_fncall_parser=true 
- rdctl pool route --scale-up 2 --pool solarisd-standby (if allowed)
- rdctl model rollback --pool solarisd-prod --to-version 2026-05-11-v2 (need approval)
Which one should I do first?
Priya Patel: Enable tolerant parser first — lowest risk. Samir, do it and paste command output. I'll coordinate with CS.
Samir Nair: running: rdctl pool update solarisd-prod --set tolerant_fncall_parser=true
```
Updating pool solarisd-prod... ok
Config applied: tolerant_fncall_parser=true
Restarting worker shards... done
```
Samir Nair: applied. Monitoring error rate.
Drew Kim: After config change, parser-exception logs decreased ~70% in the last 60s. Still seeing some escaped-string payloads causing upper-layer assertion failures.
Priya Patel: Good. Next: set up a temporary transformation in the ingress layer to attempt JSON unwrapping for payload when it's a string. I can push a small patch to canary route.
Marta Alvarez: CS updated customer — they see fewer errors but request ETA for full fix.
Priya Patel: I'll prepare a quick patch (3-line change) to coerce payload fields: if typeof payload === 'string' try JSON.parse, if null -> {} and add warning. Will push to canary.
Drew Kim: sample fix in node runtime: 
```
// safe unwrap
let payload = resp.payload;
if (typeof payload === 'string') {
  try { payload = JSON.parse(payload); } catch(e) { payload = {__warning: 'unparsable_string'} }
}
if (payload === null) payload = {__warning: 'null_payload'};
```
Patching to canary now.
Priya Patel: roll to 10% canary on solarisd-prod. rdctl rollout --pool solarisd-prod --image runtime-safe-unwrap:canary --traffic 10
Samir Nair: rollout started. Monitoring metrics.
TriageBot: Canary metrics 5m in: error-rate down 85% for canary; p95 latency +10ms. No CPU spike.
Elena Sousa: CS to customer: temporary mitigation deployed to 10% of traffic, errors reduced for those requests. Working on further rollout.
Marta Alvarez: Customer-team asking about root cause — any sign of model change?
Drew Kim: checking model catalog and recent deploys — no model roll for AsterHealth in last 24h. However, a dependency update happened in the customer's adapter (they versioned a parser lib). They claim they didn't push, but webhooks show a config redeploy around 2176542950.
Priya Patel: could be customer-side adapter producing nulls/strings. Need to coordinate. Next steps: 1) Expand canary to 50% if stable. 2) Ask customer to provide recent tool adapter logs. 3) Prepare rollback plan for our runtime change if it causes regressions.
Samir Nair: expanding canary to 50%... rdctl rollout --pool solarisd-prod --traffic 50 -> done. No red flags so far.
Drew Kim: FYI I found one failing sample where payload is "null" (string 'null') — that would have broken strict parse too. We should add tolerant handling for these cases too.
Priya Patel: Agreed. Patch updated to treat string 'null' -> {}. Pushing full rollout to 100% in 5m if metrics hold.
TriageBot: Overall impact: incidents: INC-2026-9802; affected customers: AsterHealth only (dedicated pool). Estimated % of their requests failing before mitigation: ~15%.
Elena Sousa: Customer RY: They want a postmortem and asks if this is covered by Dedicated SLA — we should confirm once mitigated. I'll open a CS ticket.
Marta Alvarez: Handoff: Priya, I'm switching to customer comms, will keep monitoring. Drew, Samir — please watch the rollout and metric dashboards. I'll be on standby.
Priya Patel: If rollout remains green, we'll close the P1 after final confirmation with CS and a short postmortem. Setting incident owner: Priya Patel.
Drew Kim: metrics look stable at 100% rollout. Error rate back to baseline. Posting final logs to /incidents/INC-2026-9802/artefacts.
Samir Nair: patch rolled back? No, we kept safe-unwrap live. Creating PR to make tolerant parser default for this pool and add a config flag in tenant settings.
Priya Patel: Good. Handoff to night on-call: @Elena Sousa will be on-call for followups, Jira INC-2026-9802 created for postmortem.
Elena Sousa: ack. I'll take the night watch and coordinate the PM.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-9802 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Closed page to primary oncall.
Priya Patel: postmortem bullets for later: - root cause: customer-side adapter started returning string/null payloads (schema drift) -> our strict parser threw exceptions. - immediate mitigation: enable tolerant parser + runtime unwrap -> prevented 100% failure. - followups: add better schema-tolerance in runtime, alert on sudden shape-change deltas, update customer guidelines.
Marta Alvarez: adding owner notes: coordinate with account team to review customer adapter logs and suggest lockstep contract for fncall schemas.
Drew Kim: leaving final note: if anyone sees recurrence ping #eng-runtime.
Elena Sousa: closing loop with customer now. Thanks team :heart:
